_comments: SALES' ACTION CATEGORY. One row, and it exists so `MJ: Actions` rows can resolve a parent by
@lookup on Name rather than baking a UUID into every action.
There was no Sales category before this. Orders has one (`Orders`), accounting reaches for the
shared `Accounting` one, and the ~50 seeded categories are MJ's own connectors and utilities --
none of them is where a sales action belongs. Reusing `CRM` was the alternative and was rejected:
it is one of MJ's own connector categories, and a sales action appearing under it would read as
part of an integration rather than part of this app.
Fixed UUID so a re-push against a rebuilt database UPDATES this row rather than creating a second
`Sales` category, which would then have actions split across two identically-named parents -- a
state nothing would flag and every action list would show twice.

fields.Name: Sales
fields.Description: Actions belonging to the BizApps Sales app: deal lifecycle, forecasting and the activity ingest.
